text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving begins. 
Symboli Kris S is apparently helping out 
at a "cafe", so I went over to check on 
her—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeek~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"New Club Member"—1 person... On the 
"Application Form," your order and— "the 
name you wish to be called"...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Stop screeching and hurry up and write. 
We're moving on to warm-ups. I'll be 
teaching you personally.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~! I went and joined♪ Senpais, please 
treat me well~♡

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So you came, Trainer. No—today— I shall 
call you my "junior"...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"That is—the rule of this establishment. 
The customer becomes—a new club member 
here at the 'Ikewuma Academy Racing 
Club'."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Now that you are a club member— your 
senpai's guidance—is absolute. 
Under—stood?
choice_data_list: Don't tell me, this cafe is...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's a "Concept Cafe"! So 
please stick to that persona!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no formal speech, remember! Um, umm, 
call me 'Tsuyoshi-senpai' today, okay!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, novel and unconventional, isn't it? 
We received many requests from fans, so I 
had a student with deep expertise in the 
subject come up with the planning and 
casting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That means today, I'm your senior as well. 
Please, enjoy yourself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Take your time――and make yourself 
comfortable. I will――return to my work.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Running this cafeâ Mission start.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Good work. I brought some black tea for 
us. If you'd like, let's chat for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Have you gotten used to the club yet? It 
might be tough to keep up at first, but 
I've been watching your hard work 
closely."

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: "Captain...! Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Rock, paper, scissors... shoot!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, I lost! Time for extra training~! 
Tsuyoshi, starting squats now!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ready, and... Hmph! Haaaaah~! Everyone, 
cheer for meeee~~~!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Keep going! Just 5 more reps! Haa... To 
think I get to see this up close...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, once you finish drinking that, we'll 
put together a training plan for ya. I'll 
take care of ya like a good senior should.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Um... to tell you the truth, I'm 
thinking of applying to Tracen Academy...! 
So please don't hold back at all!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh? So that's why you came to observe. 
...Fine by me. I won't go easy on you. 
Make sure you keep up, got it? Crawl your 
way up to me.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
......! I-I'll do my best! If I get 
accepted, I'll definitely come see you 
again!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Coffee, and carrot juice— An order... no, 
'refreshments'—

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Um, uhm...!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
No! It's nothing at all! Thank you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
S-She really is so cool...! Just like how 
she is during races.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't feel like they wanna chat, but I 
could just watch them forever...♡

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
<username>. —Sorry to keep you waiting. ...What will 
you—have?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Eh! There are still this many left? The 
cookies...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the drinks are really popular as 
expected~. The underclassmen worked hard 
to make them, but... I guess we'll just 
have to eat them at the wrap party~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"This was a miscalculation... Even though 
it turned out so delicious."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...Sorry. Orders are... later."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Cannot overlook this... 
Reprioritizing—Mission."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hmm, that's too bad...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Wait, Kris S-san?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
How many—are left unsold? We must 
swiftly—formulate a plan.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You're not seriously planning to 
sell them all, are you? There are so many 
left over, you know!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: There is――no problem. I――have an idea.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The cookies too—they must want to fulfill 
their purpose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I will not let anything—go to waste. 
Commencing promotional sales—Mission."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And in no time at all, Symboli Kris S put 
together a plan and sprang into action...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, all of you. Starting now, we 
are adding... special menu items.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, what's this...!? Whoa! They're adding 
more food that comes with games!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Its name is— the "Upset Challenge Cookie".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Come and challenge us.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple! Anyone who orders 
cookies can challenge a designated senior 
to a handicap race in the hallway, and if 
you win, you get a handshake!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
New members, run from here to there. 
Upperclassmen, run all the way to the end 
and back!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Actually running makes this feel 
even more like an after-school club. I 
mean, at that short distance, I might 
actually win...!
choice_data_list:
(That's a nice handicap. Even I might be 
able to win.)

(That's a nice handicap. Even I might be 
able to win.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Having the Student Council 
President around sure makes it easy to get 
instant approval to occupy the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As long as safety is confirmed, I can be 
that swift and decisive.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, she probably made this 
proposal with that in mind too... She 
really keeps an eye on the bigger 
picture."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An order came in right away, and the 
underdog race had begun...!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hmph—!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: This is... my victory.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"That was so close~! Wait, more like, 
getting overtaken right next to you... is 
crazy...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Swing your arms—more. If it's you—you can 
still go faster.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much~~! Wah~~! P-Please let 
me have a rematch!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"M-Me too, me too! I want to be coached by 
Kris S-senpai! I'm definitely gonna win 
and shake her hand~!!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: "Mission Accomplished. Mission complete!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
We did it! The cookies are completely sold 
out! The customers seemed to have a blast 
too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
OK. Mission accomplished— Returning 
to—standard duties.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Completing her mission and dashing away 
with flair, she truly looked like a 
consummate professional...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The special menu became a hot topic, and 
before long, a long line had formed."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Looks like we're gonna run out of 
cookies this time! I'll whip up an extra 
batch express-style! Keep it up just like 
this, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Nicely done, Kris S. It's become an 
instant hit on the menu.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: OK. Mission accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Continuing the mission, just like this...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: My next opponent is... you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
You know my running... better than anyone. 
I must... stay sharp.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Alright, take your marks... Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The plan is—use the terrain to our 
advantage and go for a pure runaway. 
Before she enters the return leg and spots 
us, we'll build up a lead...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Hm—I see...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Magnificent work, Trainer. No...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: <username>. —Well done. I offer you—my respect.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...A handshake——

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Heh... Me—your senior, huh...?
choice_data_list: Thank you! I had a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S looked amused, a rare sight 
for her. She also performed wonderfully 
during the Fan Thanksgiving Festival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"By the way... Symboli Kris S was 
apparently the most challenged target in 
the Giant-Killing Challenge."
